_comment: Questions about the cards of the fictional example kit (examples/interview/jobs/gamma-platform), asked the way an interviewer might, with words the cards' titles, key lines and phrasings mostly do not use: 14 in English, 14 in Korean. A story card counts as well when it holds the same answer. Used by docs/DECISIONS.md (Search).
questions: Give me a quick rundown of your career so far.
What draws you to our company in particular?
Which area of your work do you most need to improve?
Describe a time something you did made an outage worse.
How do you deal with a teammate who pushes back on your plan?
It is 2 a.m. and checkout latency spikes. What are your first steps?
Suppose I ask about something you never studied. What then?
Before we finish, is there anything you would like to know about the team?
How did you break the monolith into pieces that deploy on their own?
Every team released its own way. How did you bring that together?
How did billing and notifications find out an order changed?
A client retries a request. How do you make sure the customer is charged once?
Explain declarative deployment driven from a repository.
Can you see my slides and hear me clearly?
간단하게 지금까지 걸어온 길을 얘기해 주실래요?
여러 회사 중에 왜 하필 여기를 골랐어요?
스스로 고쳐야 한다고 생각하는 부분이 있나요?
새벽에 결제 응답 시간이 튀면 제일 먼저 뭘 보세요?
처음 듣는 개념을 물어보면 어떻게 대답하실 거예요?
마지막으로 저희 팀에 대해 알고 싶은 거 있으세요?
승인 기능을 따로 떼어 낸 과정을 설명해 주세요
팀마다 제각각이던 배포를 어떻게 하나로 모았어요?
정산이랑 알림 쪽은 주문 정보를 어디서 받아 갔어요?
같은 결제 요청이 두 번 들어오면 어떻게 막아요?
